title: Classify an object, most specific type first

blocks.text: `obj instanceof Type` is `true` when `obj` is a `Type` or any subtype of it, and `false` for `null`. So a chain of checks tests the most specific type first: every `Integer` is also a `Number`. It works with arrays too, and an `int[]` is not an `Object[]`.

cases.says: Doubles and Longs are numbers, Strings and builders are text.
42 is "integer": the Integer check comes before the Number one.
An int[] is "int array" and a String[] is "object array".

concepts: instanceof works with array types, and an int[] is not an Object[].
instanceof is true for a type and all its subtypes, so checks go from the most specific type to the least.
